items.title: Filter settings now apply without a restart
items.description: trackingAccuracyThreshold, odometerAccuracyThreshold, maxImpliedSpeed and useKalmanFilter used to be accepted and then ignored until the next cold start. They take effect on the next fix, and the odometer keeps its anchor.

items.title: See which thresholds are actually in force
items.description: getCurrentLocationTuning() reads back from the native location processor instead of echoing your config — so you can tell what the filters are really using, including a transport-mode auto-tune you did not set.

items.title: Docs for older versions
items.description: The version dropdown next to the logo switches between the current docs and frozen archives of previous releases.
